items.quote: He sought God during the days of Zechariah, who instructed him in the fear of God.
items.contrast: Uzziah as the person Zechariah instructed versus Amaziah, who is mentioned only as Uzziah’s father.
items.reason: Amaziah is a plausible distraction because he is named immediately beforehand, but he appears only in a comparison with Uzziah. Uzziah remains the subject of “He sought God,” and “him” refers back to Uzziah, so the key is uniquely supported. Resolving that reference makes this a meaningful comprehension question.
